Key near-term risks include Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech (potential hawkish signal), U.S. midterm elections in November adding volatility, and growing leverage at megacap tech firms. BofA is a notable bear at 7,100. A seasonal sell-off post-Labor Day is anticipated, followed by a year-end rally into 2027.
